name: Greater Natural Weapon Focus
body:
Choose one type of natural attack (bite, claw, slam, gore, etc.) for which you have already selected Weapon Focus. You are a master of this attack.

Prerequisite(s): Shapeshifter Shapechange, Form of the Mythical Beast, Form of the Dragon, or Giant Form class feature. Weapon Focus with selected natural attack, base attack bonus +1, 8th-level shapeshifter.

Benefit(s): You gain a +1 bonus on attack rolls you make using the selected natural attack. This bonus stacks with other bonuses on attack rolls, including those from Weapon Focus.
